## Installing on Windows

Download **`micold-ai-ide-<version>-x64-setup.exe`** for most PCs, or **`micold-ai-ide-<version>-arm64-setup.exe`** for Windows on ARM64. Run it; it installs for your account only and asks for no administrator rights.

The installer is not code-signed, so SmartScreen stops the first run: click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Full instructions, including limits and removal: [Installing on Windows](https://github.com/jaroslawherod/micold-ai-ide/blob/main/docs/user-guide/install-windows.md)
